subject: Computação
description_pt: Criar, documentar e publicar de forma individual ou colaborativa, produtos (vídeos, podcasts, web sites) usando recursos de tecnologia. Selecionar e utilizar tecnologias computacionais para se expressar e resolver problemas, analisando criticamente os diferentes impactos na sociedade.

components.description_pt: Criar um produto digital como vídeo, podcast ou website usando recursos tecnológicos disponíveis
components.description_en: Create a digital product such as a video, podcast, or website using available technology resources

components.description_pt: Documentar e publicar um produto digital individualmente ou colaborativamente
components.description_en: Document and publish a digital product individually or collaboratively

components.description_pt: Selecionar tecnologias computacionais apropriadas para expressar ideias ou resolver problemas específicos
components.description_en: Select appropriate computational technologies to express ideas or solve specific problems
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate tools, technologies, or models to analyze a given scientific data set

components.description_pt: Analisar criticamente impactos sociais de tecnologias computacionais usadas em produção digital
components.description_en: Critically analyze the social impacts of computational technologies used in digital production
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

cc_matches.description: Analyze data using tools, technologies, and/or models (e.g., computational, mathematical) in order to make valid and reliable scientific claims or determine an optimal design solution.

Evaluate a solution to a complex real-world problem based on prioritized criteria and trade-offs that account for a range of constraints, including cost, safety, reliability, and aesthetics as well as possible social, cultural, and environmental impacts.
